usedFor: WPForms collects your form entries and HubSpot keeps the contacts, so “New Form Entry” runs “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Entry” in WPForms, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A submission creates the contact or updates the existing one by email.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” matches on email, so the form needs an email field.
